content:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted egress surge detected in us-west + eu1 causing elevated 429/502s for chunked/streaming responses.
incident-bot: Affected services: hosted API (generate/stream), embeddings upload pipeline. Mitigation in progress. Status: investigating.
incident-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.status/runbooks/egress-surge | Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2188800000
jules: I'm the ops lead, heading mitigation. Immediate actions: 1) throttle large response streaming, 2) scale egress proxy pool + spin up extra small-workers in eu1, 3) route heavy customers to dedicated path.
jules: Doing rolling restart of edge-proxies in us-west to clear stuck connections, ETA ~12m. I'll post progress.
ashok: Deployed streaming-shed patch to canary in us-west-1 (traffic split 10%). Observed request error rate drop from ~18% -> ~5% for canary.
ashok: Also applying response-size caps at the router layer (`max_response_bytes=2_000_000`) to prevent queue bloat.
kevin: Root cause hypothesis: upstream CDN/peering hit severe backpressure causing long tail socket writes. We're switching to direct egress for large payloads where possible and disabling HTTP/2 multiplexing for affected proxies.
kevin: Telemetry: `egress_queue_depth > 5000` peaked at 09:11 UTC, now trending down after canary.
prod-oncall: Quick check (metrics):
```
# check egress queue depth
curl -sS 'https://metrics.internal/api/query?m=egress_queue_depth&region=us-west&since=600' | jq .
```
prod-oncall: I ran that, queue depth dropped ~60% in canary zones.
sophie: Support: drafting customer note for impacted customers. Short version: "We detected transient errors for high-volume streaming requests; mitigation applied; if you still see errors please contact support@redwood.ai with request IDs."
sophie: Will post to #support and outbound template shortly.
maya: CS: Please DM me the top-10 tenants by error rate so I can prioritize outreach. Also want to confirm SLA hit calc for today's window.
jules: sending list in private. Also tagging eng-sre for root-cause postmortem: @kevin @ashok
kevin: Logging capture enabled for affected proxies, collected `tcp_drops` and `write_time` samples. We'll correlate with peering logs.
jules: Current impact: partial customer-facing errors for ~3% of hosted traffic, concentrated on large streaming responses. Mitigations reduced impact; customers on Dedicated unaffected.
jules: Next update in 15 minutes or earlier if status changes. If you need to be paged call `#oncall-escalation`.
incident-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: mitigation in progress — reduced error rate, no data loss reported. Follow status page for live updates.
